chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 97: Bashe Descends — Li Huowang’s Deadly Bargain
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang weaponizes his own agony to borrow power from the god of Pain, Bashe. A devastating victory leads to the cruelest question: which world is real?
og_title: Li Huowang trades his pain for a god’s power — but at what cost?
og_description: Bashe awakens. In a moment of desperate genius, Li Huowang turns his own agony into a weapon that even an unfeeling demon cannot survive. But when he wakes up, the real battle begins.
twitter_title: He borrowed from the God of Pain. Now he has to pay it back.
twitter_description: Li Huowang’s sacrifice is a masterpiece of pain. He wins the fight, but the hospital bed is waiting, and so is the doctor who asks if any of it was real.
